title: Choose the visual world for The Tooth Care, premium and modern
question: You pinned the register: premium and modern, not homely. Three worlds at that register, plus the premium category standard. You pick.

options.label: The Private Practice
options.lineage: Harley Street and Singapore specialist practices: quiet reception, one large photograph, precise typography, nothing loud
options.thesis: Confidence through restraint. A near-white page, a refined serif, large calm photography, and the logo navy used with discipline.
materials: a light high-contrast serif for headings, a crisp grotesk for body
one muted brass detail on the logo line
options.viewport: A wide, quiet header with the logo and both phones. Then a two-column hero: a large candid photo of the dentist with a patient on the right, and on the left a light serif headline, 'We talk first. Then we treat.', a two-line promise, the navy Message us on WhatsApp button and a plain Call link. A hairline rule, then the real numbers set large: 4.8 on Google, two chambers, open daily till 11 PM.
options.risk: Restraint reads empty if the photography is not excellent; until photos arrive the page shows labelled frames. Very close to what high-end competitors ship, distinguished by execution and the 'we' voice.

options.label: The Evening Suite
options.lineage: High-end hospitality at night: a deep navy lobby, warm lamplight on faces, brass details, a concierge who knows your name
options.thesis: Cared for like a guest. The logo navy owns the whole page as a deep evening ground; warm photography and off-white type glow against it. Open till 11 PM becomes the mood, not a footnote.
materials: deep navy ground owning 60 percent of the surface
options.viewport: Full-bleed deep navy. Top-left the logo in off-white, top-right both phones. Centre-left a large off-white headline, 'Evening appointments, unhurried care.', with a warm-lit candid photo bleeding in from the right. Beneath the headline a brass-outlined Message us on WhatsApp button and the line 'Open daily till 11 PM, Bashundhara and Nadda'. Sections alternate navy and off-white panels down the page.
options.risk: Dark pages photograph beautifully and can feel like a hotel or a bar rather than a clinic; the dental facts and the team must appear early. Contrast and legibility need discipline on cheap phone screens in daylight.

options.label: The Architect's Practice
options.lineage: Contemporary architecture and design-studio sites: strict editorial grid, hairlines, oversized numerals, photography of real space
options.thesis: Modern through structure. A rigorous grid, hairline rules, very large numerals for the facts, and photography of the actual rooms and people, so the clinic reads as a designed place.
materials: photography of rooms and people in daylight
navy reserved for actions and the logo
options.viewport: A visible 12-column grid. Top row: logo, a one-line nav, phones. A full-width photograph of the Bashundhara chamber interior with people in it. Below, a three-column row: a large grotesk headline 'Dentistry, explained before it is done.', a short promise, and the navy Message us on WhatsApp button. Then a numerals row: 4.8, 52 reviews, 2 chambers, 23:00.
options.risk: The coldest of the three; warmth must come entirely from people in the photographs. Needs interior photography of the clinic that does not exist yet.

canonCard.label: The premium category standard
canonCard.thesis: The modern clinic site the best competitors ship, executed at full craft with the 'we' voice and real facts.
canonCard.viewport: Header with logo and phone, hero with a large photo, a warm headline, trust line, and a blue Message us on WhatsApp button; then services in a grid, reviews, the team, locations with maps, footer. When chosen, you name two or three clinic sites it should sit alongside.
canonCard.risk: Familiar by design; it earns trust through polish and real content, not distinctiveness.
